tools.name: tonights_consensus
tools.description: Tonight's games where the sports cappers Slipstream ranks agree, with how many cappers are on each game and how they split. Use it when someone asks what cappers are on tonight or where they agree. Takes an optional league. The sides themselves and the cappers on them are not returned.

tools.name: capper_record
tools.description: One sports capper's record, looked up by X (Twitter) handle: wins, losses and units over the last 30 days on the picks Slipstream tracks, dated, with their place on the standings and a link to their page. Use it when someone asks whether a capper is winning or what their record is. A handle Slipstre

tools.name: capper_standings
tools.description: The sports cappers who are up the most units, ranked, with each one's record, units and page, tracked from their public posts on X (Twitter). Use it when someone asks which cappers are winning, who leads a league or who is hot right now. Takes an optional league (NBA, NFL, college football, NHL) and

tools.name: open_sides
tools.description: Tonight's consensus sides with the cappers on each. Needs a Slipstream Pro account.

tools.name: capper_open_picks
tools.description: A tracked capper's open picks tonight. Needs a Slipstream Pro account.

tools.name: ask_scout
tools.description: Ask Scout, Slipstream's assistant, about cappers and tonight's consensus. Needs a Slipstream Pro account.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "tonights_consensus" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
